help.usage: Send the token in the {header} header.
help.stepUp: Tokens cannot perform actions that require re-authentication.
help.audit: Requests made with a token are recorded in the audit log with the source “API”.

create.title: Create token
create.allowedIpsHint: Optional. Limits the token to these IP addresses or CIDR ranges, for example 203.0.113.0/24.

created.title: Copy your new token now
created.warning: You will not see it again. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.

confirmRevoke.title: Revoke token {name}?
confirmRevoke.content: Programs using this token will no longer be able to access the panel.
